# The scriptent mover verbs on the retail 1.1d Linux dedicated server,
# mp_pavlov, dm, 2026-09-09. The server half of the capture: what
# `getorigin()` and `.angles` read once per server frame while each verb runs,
# and when the completion notify fires.
#
# Taken with two shells, the second attached 18 s in so it lands inside the
# wire loop:
#
#   COD_DIR=... COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PROBE_SECS=75 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_mover mp_pavlov
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --probe-secs 45
#
# The client half is mp_pavlov-dm-movers-wire.txt, from the same run.
#
# `PROBE p <phase> <levelTime ms> <getorigin()> <.angles>` is one server frame.
# `PROBE done <phase> <event> ...` is the completion notify. The `wire_*` lines
# are the concurrent loop the client half reads; nothing is sampled per frame
# for them.
